name: wp-ja-kinetic/popular-tags
title: Popular tags
description: Top-N tags ordered by post count DESC, then name ASC — the source's own sort on every tag rail it draws (`category/blog.php` browse-strip tags, `category/thumbs.php` sidebar tags, `archive/default.php` tags rail: all `ORDER BY cnt DESC, title ASC`). Core's `wp:tag-cloud` block has no ordering attribute (`wp_generate_tag_cloud()` orders by name); this reads `get_tags()` directly instead.

linkClassName.description: The source uses a different per-context pill class on every tag rail it draws (e.g. `hxcat-chip` on the thumbs sidebar) — never its own generic name.
